purpose: Bound the practical prediction impact of the unresolved historical feature-name discrepancy: preserved label '30d' versus the strongest forensic reconstruction RELIEVER_STINT_PREGAME_CALENDAR36_P25.5.
model_selection_rule: This policy does not choose or retune the model from future outcomes. It only decides whether the calendar36/calendar30 implementation discrepancy is practically small enough to stop blocking research-shadow promotion.

required_prospective_sample.source_requirement: Only immutable PROSPECTIVE_CLEAN_PRE_RESEARCH snapshots captured market-unseen are eligible.
required_prospective_sample.reason: This gate measures deterministic implementation sensitivity rather than predictive accuracy. Historical frozen-moment/coefficient/OOS evidence already exists; the live sample is for practical breadth across dates and teams.

signed_bias.definition: Mean of calendar30/P39.25 minus active calendar36/P25.5 score deltas across eligible team-score fields.

decision_stability_gate.definition: Predicted side is the team with larger Full-game mu. A flip is forbidden when the active absolute Full mu margin is at least 0.25 runs.

interpretation.PASS: All sample-size and discrepancy thresholds pass. The 30d-label/calendar36 discrepancy is practically bounded for promotion purposes, but exact source-code recovery remains unproven.
interpretation.WAIT: Prospective sample breadth is insufficient; keep collecting immutable snapshots without changing thresholds.
interpretation.FAIL: At least one preregistered discrepancy threshold is exceeded; Official Mechanical Shadow remains blocked and the discrepancy must be investigated rather than thresholds relaxed post hoc.

discipline: Thresholds are frozen before eligible prospective comparison results are observed. Any later threshold change must create a new version and cannot retroactively qualify already observed snapshots under the old gate.
